app.name: Wishlist
app.tagline: Paste a link, we fill in the rest.
social.title: Social
social.subtitle: Your friends and their lists, all in one place.
social.noFriends: No friends yet. Search for someone or share your invite link.
social.findBody: Search by profile name or name and send an invitation.
social.noResults: Nobody found. Check the profile name, or share your invite link.
social.inviteBody: Anyone who opens this link can add you as a friend.
collab.title: Fill it in together
collab.body: Invite friends to work on this list with you. Everyone can add and edit gifts; the settings stay yours and apply to everybody. Up to {max} people at a time.
collab.noFriends: All your friends are already in. Share the link below instead.
collab.full: This list is full: at most {max} people can work on it.
collab.leaveConfirm: You'll stop taking part in this list. Continue?
collab.memberNotice: You're working on this list. Adding and editing gifts is fine; the settings stay with the owner.
collab.joinBody: {name} invites you to work on '{title}' together.
collab.joined: You're in! Feel free to add gifts.
settings.bioPlaceholder: E.g. Loves cooking, plants and far too much coffee.
settings.bioHint: This goes on your profile, so anyone with your link can read it.
profile.publicListsBody: These are on your profile; anyone with your link sees them.
profile.noPublicLists: No list on your profile yet. Set a list to 'Also on my profile' to make it show up here.
profile.hiddenBody: {count} lists that aren't on your profile
profile.hiddenBodyOne: 1 list that isn't on your profile
profile.complete: Add a photo and a bio
landing.title: Wishlists that fill themselves in
landing.subtitle: Paste a product link and Wishlist automatically pulls in the name, the photo and the price. Share your list with a single link so nobody buys the same gift twice.
landing.step1.title: Paste a link
landing.step1.body: From bol.com, Coolblue, Amazon or any other web shop.
landing.step2.title: Tweak anything
landing.step2.body: Everything is filled in already. Change the name, price, photo or add a size.
landing.step3.title: Share your list
landing.step3.body: One link for family and friends. They see what has been bought, you don't.
landing.surprise.title: The surprise stays a surprise
landing.surprise.body: Who claimed a gift is visible to other visitors, but never to you. Nobody buys twice and you stay surprised.
auth.name: Name
auth.registerSubtitle: Your first list in under a minute.
auth.loginSubtitle: Log in to manage your lists.
error.invalid-email: That doesn't look like a valid email address.
error.email-taken: An account with this email already exists.
error.handle-invalid: Use only letters, numbers and dashes.
error.storage-unconfigured: This deployment doesn't see any photo storage. In Vercel, go to Storage, open your Blob store, click 'Connect Project' and pick gift-app with all three environments ticked. Then hit Redeploy under Deployments — a connected store only takes effect after a new deploy.
error.image-too-large: That photo is too large and couldn't be shrunk. Try one from your photo library, or make a smaller version yourself.
error.storage-failed: Storage didn't respond. Please try again in a moment.
error.storage-token-invalid: The photo storage key isn't being accepted. Reconnect Blob to the project in Vercel (Storage › Connect Project) and redeploy afterwards.
error.storage-store-missing: The photo storage no longer exists. Create a new Blob store under Storage in Vercel, connect it to this project and redeploy.
error.storage-suspended: Photo storage is paused in Vercel. Check your account under Storage.
error.storage-busy: Photo storage is busy right now. Try again in a minute.
error.storage-type-blocked: This kind of file isn't allowed in photo storage.
error.heic-image: This photo is in Apple's HEIC format and couldn't be converted. Take a screenshot of it, or set your device to 'Most Compatible' under Settings › Camera › Formats.
error.unsupported-image: We don't recognise this file as a photo. Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP.
error.too-many-uploads: You've uploaded a lot of photos just now. Wait a moment and try again.
error.session-expired: You've been signed out. Sign in again and retry.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

share.disabled: This list is set to 'Only me' and cannot be shared.

scrape.failed: We couldn't read this page. Please fill it in below.
scrape.partial: We couldn't get everything — please double-check.
scrape.blocked: This shop blocks automatic reading. Please fill it in yourself.
scrape.blockedPartial: {shop} won't let us read the page. We filled in what the link revealed — check the name and add the price yourself.
scrape.archived: This shop won't let us in, so we used an archived copy of the page. The name and photo are right; please double-check the price, it may be out of date.
scrape.invalidUrl: Paste a complete link, for example https://www.bol.com/…
visitor.intro: Click a gift to go to the shop. Let others know what you're buying so nobody buys the same thing.
visitor.hiddenNotice: {name} cannot see what has been claimed — the surprise stays intact.
visitor.notFound.title: List not found
visitor.notFound.body: This link is wrong or the list is no longer shared.

settings.title: Settings
settings.logoutBody: You stay logged in on this device until you log out here.
settings.storageBody: Check whether uploading your own photos works. We store a test file and remove it right away.
settings.storageOkBlob: Photo storage works. You can upload your own photos.
settings.storageOkLocal: Saving works, but through the server's file system. On Vercel you need a Blob store for this.
bookmarklet.title: Save button for your browser
bookmarklet.intro: Some shops, like bol.com, don't let our server in. This button reads a product from your own device while you're on the product page. To the shop you're just a regular visitor, so this works everywhere.
bookmarklet.desktopSteps: Drag the orange button to your bookmarks bar. That's it. Next time you're on a product page, click that bookmark.
bookmarklet.iphone2: Bookmark this page using the share icon.
bookmarklet.iphone3: Open your bookmarks, tap 'Edit' and choose the bookmark you just saved.
bookmarklet.iphone4: Replace the address with the copied code and name the bookmark 'Save to Wishlist'.
bookmarklet.privacy: The button only sends the product's name, price, photo and link — nothing else from the page you're on.
bookmarklet.addBody: Read from the product page. Pick a list and change whatever you like.
bookmarklet.needList: Create a list first, then you can save gifts into it.
bookmarklet.savedBody: The gift is in your list. You can close this tab.
footer.made: Built to make gift giving easier.
